nestedKey.name: lot_decisions
nestedKey.script: [{'lot_id': row.lot_id, 'lot_product': row.product_id, 'lot_expires_on': row.expires_on} for row in lots]

key.name: excluded_by
key.script: 'A3' if lot_product != parent.product_id else 'A1' if parent.ship_on > lot_expires_on else None

array.name: eligible_lots
array.script: [row['lot_id'] for row in lot_decisions if row['excluded_by'] is None]
